title: Certify four seven-source B exclusions with checked SAT proofs
body:
## Summary

```text
B1..B4 native exclusions already exist
+ independent occupied-vertex CNF
+ fresh CaDiCaL proofs checked by separate DRAT-trim
```

Certify the four exact simple22 pattern-B templates in `research/connector-b-occupancy-sat/RESULT.json`. The new implementation retains all 112 ordered Q3 paths and encodes literal prefix occupancy, joins, counts, simplicity and all nonzero differences. It imports no predecessor search, capacity or propagation code.

This adds independent proof evidence, with no new f(7) value or kappa. The predecessor's retained SMT record gives only aggregate counts, three UNSAT and 74 timeouts. Each named case's prior SMT status is explicitly **unknown**; no newly resolved named case is claimed. The remaining 73 templates are unrun here.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3058's complete B exclusion rests on its native implementation. The representation, pruning, search and caller audits preserve independent full-B checking as an open obligation.
  **After:** four source-bound CNFs, each with 25,969 variables, produce proofs accepted by separately pinned DRAT-trim. Exact CNF/proof hashes and complete checker transcripts are committed. Raw proof traces regenerate during replay and are removed after checking.
- Thirteen semantic groups pass normally and optimized, including actual simple24 SAT, noncover22 SAT only without coverage, equal-count symmetry with a positive word, repeated-prefix rejection, exact small cardinality truth tables, incomplete-result rejection and actual native template-ID agreement. Valid, empty and forged checker controls also pass.
- The generic registered hook passes **bindings only**, explicitly `no_UNSAT_replay`. Full proof replay has a separate pinned environment and manual native workflow because PySAT is outside the generic dependency allowlist. Ruff checks, formatting, selected baseline bindings and committed-byte/source-history checks pass locally. A fresh read-only Git-free export of the exact commit also passes all four proof checks. Hosted workflow execution is not claimed.

Reproduction, translation proof, exact source pins, prior-status limits and observed evidence are in the package README, PROOF.md, REPLAY.json, PRIOR-STATUS.json and CHECKS.json. Canonical main remains `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Scientific commit `05d288a9778383102f65a0885fc7196e85360a38`.

Credit conorholds/PR3058, Krzysztof Wojt/PR3261, the retained capacity/propagation/search/caller audits, Nicholas Stone, Aaron Wang, James Reed, Ross Richardson/PR943 and Douglas Colkitt/PR1185. The vendored DRAT-trim source retains its exact upstream commit and MIT license. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-19007773).

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. This adds one isolated research package and one manual verification workflow.

Blast radius: package. Selected records and frozen predecessors stay unchanged. The native checker retains documented upstream compiler warnings; the replay requires POSIX libc and pinned PySAT. No full B/classification audit, physical supplier, complete multiplication theorem or selected-frontier update is claimed.
